title: Continental Drainage Summit Route
description: Given an m x n matrix of non-negative integers representing the altitude of terrain across a continent, rainwater can flow directly to adjacent cells (north, south, east, west) with a height equal to or lower than the current cell. The continent is bordered by two water bodies: the Western-Northern ocean and the Eastern-Southern ocean. Find a list of grid coordinates where rainwater can flow to both oceans.
output_format: A list of coordinate pairs [r, c] where water can flow to both oceans.

examples.explanation: These coordinates can reach both the top/left edge and the bottom/right edge.
All coordinates can reach both boundaries.
Single cell connects to both boundaries.
